description: exactly ONE finding, naming the on_key registration, even though an every appears inside it. The on_key registration is what accumulates - one more per tick - while the inner every 10 is guarded by a key press and only misbehaves because the outer already did; fix the outer and it disappears. Reporting both would put two warnings on one line for a single defect and would teach that the guarded inner form is itself suspect, contradicting the user-bounded carve-out

diagnostics.message: every runs again and again, so this on_key adds another handler every time. register it once, outside the every.
